scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day~
I'm {1}, your
guide to exploring
the Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您好~
我是{1}，
将为您导览
艾音布罗克中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Einbroch Tower offers
the best view of our city
and it's a great place to
meet with friends or take
a date. The Einbroch Tower
admission fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾音布罗克中央塔
拥有俯瞰本市的最佳视野，
也是与朋友聚会或
约会的绝佳场所。
中央塔的入场费为10泽尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, we're offering
a special promotion called
the Apple Combo Set for only
20 zeny. This set includes
Einbroch Tower admission
and an Apple to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在我们正在进行
特别促销活动，
只需20泽尼即可购买
“苹果组合套餐”。
该套餐包含中央塔入场费
以及一份苹果零食。

scripts.text: Tower Admission Only
scripts.translation: 仅限中央塔入场

scripts.text: Apple Combo Set
scripts.translation: 苹果组合套餐

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny. The Einbroch
Tower Admission
fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的
泽尼不足。
中央塔的入场费
是10泽尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您
使用我们的服务。
请允许我立刻为您
带路前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny. The
Apple Combo Set is 20 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的
泽尼不足。
苹果组合套餐的价格是20泽尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before I guide you to
the tower, let me check
your status to insure
your safety before I give
you the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在带您前往中央塔之前，
请允许我先检查您的状态，
以确保在为您提供
苹果组合套餐前您的安全。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您
使用我们的服务。
请允许我立刻为您
带路前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you're carrying
too many items with you. Please store some of your things in your Kafra Storage before purchasing
the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您携带的物品过多。
在购买苹果组合套餐之前，
请先将部分物品存入您的卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Feel free to
come back any
time. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。
欢迎随时
再次光临。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
Greetings,
I am Morei,
Assistant Guide
of Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[Morei]
您好，
我是Morei，
艾音布罗克中央塔的
助手向导。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
If you wish to return
to the ground floor,
please let me know.
Would you like to go
back to ground level?
scripts.translation:
[Morei]
如果您想返回
地面层，
请告知我。
您想要返回地面层吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 要。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
Let me lead you
to the ground floor.
Thank you for using
our services.
scripts.translation:
[Morei]
我明白了。
请让我带您
前往地面层。
感谢您
使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
I hope you
enjoy your time
in Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[Morei]
我明白了。
希望您在
艾音布罗克中央塔
度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Welcome to
the Train Station.
Trains to Einbech
are always running
so if you miss one,
it's no problem.
scripts.translation:
[Staff]
欢迎来到
火车站。
前往艾音贝赫的列车
班次频繁，
所以即使错过了一班
也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The fare to board the
train that runs the Einbroch
to Einbech line is 200 zeny.
Would you like to buy a ticket?
scripts.translation:
[Staff]
搭乘艾音布罗克至艾音贝赫
线路列车的车费为200泽尼。
您要买票吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 要。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: About the Environment...
scripts.translation: 关于环境...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you
very much.
Have a safe trip.
^333333*Ahem*^000000 All aboard!
scripts.translation:
[Staff]
非常感谢。
祝您旅途平安。
^333333*咳咳*^000000 全体上车！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough zeny
to pay the train fare.
scripts.translation:
[Staff]
很抱歉，您的
泽尼不足以
支付车费。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Very well, then.
Please enjoy your
stay in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
好的，那么。
请在艾音布罗克
愉快地停留吧。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Einbroch is infamous for
its air pollution, no doubt
caused by the industrial
facilities located here.
It's really horrible...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
艾音布罗克因空气污染而臭名昭著，
毫无疑问，这是由于这里的
工业设施造成的。
真的太可怕了……

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Sometimes the air pollution
gets so bad that it becomes
hard to breathe. If you hear
the Einbroch Smog Alert, you
should find shelter immediately!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
有时空气污染会变得非常严重，
让人难以呼吸。如果你听到
艾音布罗克雾霾警报，
你应该立即寻找避难所！

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Laaaand sakes!

[Leslie]
An old woman like me
can't breathe this air! How
do people even live in all this
smog? Sure, the air in Einbech
isn't pristine, but the air here in Einbroch is much worse! ^333333*Cough~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
像我这样的老太婆
根本没法呼吸这种空气！
人们到底是怎么在这些雾霾里
生活的？没错，艾音贝赫的空气
也不算纯净，但艾音布罗克的
空气要糟糕得多！^333333*咳~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
I hate coming here
sometimes! The air is
totally polluted and this
city is full of stuck up
pricks! But they sell stuff
here I can't buy back home...
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
有时候我真讨厌来这里！
空气完全被污染了，而且这城市里
到处都是自命不凡的混蛋！
但这里卖的东西，我在老家
却买不到……

scripts.text:
[Tan]
All the factories
here in Einbroch are
causing a serious air
pollution problem.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
艾音布罗克这里的
所有工厂都在造成
严重的空气污染问题。

scripts.text:
[Tan]
I'm an Airship engineer and
everyday, all day long, I deal
with oil stains and all sorts
of pollutants. I'm surprised
I haven't gotten sick yet...
scripts.translation:
[谭]
我是一名飞空艇工程师，
每天整天都在处理油渍和
各种各样的污染物。我很惊讶
自己居然还没生病……

scripts.text:
[Tan]
Still, I try to be careful
when I can. Whenever I go
out into the city's red fog,
I always wear my Flu Mask.
If you'll be here for a while,
you should carry one with you.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
尽管如此，我还是会尽量
小心谨慎。每当我走进城市的
红雾中时，我总是会戴上口罩。
如果你会在这里待上一段时间，
你也应该随身携带一个。

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
Excuse me...
But I'm lost!
I can't find my
mom or dad!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
打扰一下……
但我迷路了！
我找不到我
爸爸妈妈了！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
A-am I at the Airport?!
My parents are supposed
to come get me, but I still
haven't found them! We just
moved here, so I don't know
where anything is!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
我——我是不是在机场？！
我的父母应该来接我的，
但我还是没找到他们！我们刚
搬到这里，所以我不知道
哪里是什么地方！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
W-wait!
Where are you
going?! Don't leave
me, I'm all alone...!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
等——等等！
你要去哪里？！
别丢下我，我只有一个人……！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
H-hey! Don't
touch my precious
Burielle! I just finished
her tune-up and now she's
sleeping! J-just step away!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
喂！别碰我珍贵的
Burielle！我刚给她做完
保养，她现在正在睡觉！快——快走开！

scripts.text: Who's Burielle?
scripts.translation: Burielle是谁？

scripts.text: Sorry about That.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Burielle is the prettiest
model among all the Airships
made within the last ten years!
She might be grounded now, but
with my healing hands, she'll
conquer the skies again!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
Burielle是过去十年里
制造的所有飞空艇中最漂亮的一款！
她现在可能无法飞行，但在我
神奇的双手修复下，她一定会
再次征服天空的！

scripts.text: Ah~
scripts.translation: 啊~

scripts.text: Uh huh...
scripts.translation: 嗯哼……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah~
I see, so you're
working on restoring
this magnificent specimen
of an Airship. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~
我明白了，原来你正在努力
修复这架华丽的飞空艇。
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Yeah. I'd appreciate
it if you'd just be careful.
I've put a lot of love into
fixing up Burielle...
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
是啊。如果你能小心点的话，
我会很感激的。
我在修理Burielle时投入了
很多心血……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh huh...
Right. For a second
there, I thought you were
talking about a person, but
then I also assumed that you
weren't, you know, a nutcase.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯哼...
好吧。刚才那一瞬间，
我还以为你在说某个人，
但随后我也默认你
并不是个疯子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, did you say,
''prettiest model?''
All Airships look the
same to me, this one
ain't special at all. You've
gone loony tunes, paley boy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，你刚才说，
“最漂亮的型号”？
在我看来所有的飞空艇
都长得一样，这艘根本
没什么特别的。你疯了，
小伙子。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Wh-what...?!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
什、什么...？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Well, at least you know
what you did wrong. Now
quit disturbing her and git!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
好吧，至少你知道
自己做错了什么。现在
别再打扰她了，快滚！

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
I've lived here for
a long time and I see
that this huge city is still
growing bigger everyday.
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
我在这里住了很久，
我看到这座巨大的城市
每天都在变得更加繁华。

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
How did Einbroch get so
huge so quickly? I still can't
believe there's been this much
development. Well, I suppose
it's not my concern. Nothing
I do will make a difference...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
艾音布罗克是怎么这么快
就变得这么庞大的？我还是
不敢相信会有这么大的
开发规模。好吧，我想这
并不关我的事。无论我做
什么都改变不了什么...

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
Even though such
rapid industrialization
can't be good for the
environment or the people,
I'll just sit back, watch what
happens and just enjoy life...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
虽然如此快速的
工业化可能对环境
或人们并不利，但我会
静观其变，只是享受生活...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
Jiminy! The air here
is so thick and grimy!
And it's worse for us old
people with breathing
problems! ^333333*Haaack!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
天哪！这里的空气
又厚又脏！
对于我们这些有呼吸
问题的老人来说更是
糟糕透了！^333333*咳咳！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
I don't care if they keep
building more and more
factories and homes in this
town. Still, I'd like to spend
the rest of my life somewhere
quiet and with clean air...
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
我不在乎他们是否要在
镇上建造越来越多的
工厂和房屋。尽管如此，我
还是想在余生里找个安静
且空气清新地方度过...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
Then again, Einbroch is my
hometown and I can't just up
and leave. I suppose it's my
fate to suffer from this foul air until the day I die. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
话又说回来，艾音布罗克
是我的家乡，我不能就这么
离开。我想我注定要忍受
这污浊的空气直到死的那天。
^666666*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
Lately, there's been
talk about this empty
building downtown that's
been converted into some
sort of mysterious facility.
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
最近，有人在谈论市中心
那栋空房子，据说它被
改造成了某种神秘的设施。

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
It all seems pretty
shady, but I guess it's
not really my job to know
about that. I mean, if it
doesn't affect me, why
should I be concerned?
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
这一切看起来都很可疑，
但我想了解这些并不是
我的职责。我的意思是，
如果它不影响到我，我
为什么要担心呢？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Surprisingly, we have
a Train Station that everyone
has been calling a victory for
science. I mean, shouldn't we
be more amazed by the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
令人惊讶的是，我们竟然
有了一个被大家称为
科学胜利的火车站。我的意思是，
我们难道不应该对飞空艇
感到更惊叹吗？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Now, if you want to know
where the train actually goes,
I wouldn't be able to tell you.
After all, I never rode it. But
still, I guess having our own
Train Station is a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
现在，如果你想知道
火车到底开往哪里，
我也没法告诉你。毕竟，
我从没坐过。不过，我想
拥有自己的火车站也是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
...And that's why
I travel around the
globe. My bosses have
a keen eye for the most
exotic goods, so I acquire
them and make deliveries.
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
...这就是为什么
我环游世界的原因。
我的老板对各种稀有的
货物都有敏锐的眼光，
所以我负责采购并送货。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
There even was a time
when they had me collect
Jellopy, though that stuff is
pretty common nowadays.
Now that I think about it, why
did they need so much stuff?
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
甚至还有一段时间，
他们让我去收集杰勒比结晶，
虽然那东西现在已经很常见了。
现在回想起来，他们当时
为什么需要那么多呢？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
Now, I hear that the
monsters around here
carry around some ore
that dazzles with a sublimely
beautiful light. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
对了，我听说这附近的
怪物身上带着一些矿石，
散发着一种极其美丽的
光芒。很酷，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
These ores are a great
material to use in making
flower vases. My friend, who
happens to be a doll maker,
told me that. He makes these dolls using all sorts of materials.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
这些矿石是制作花瓶的
绝佳材料。我有一个朋友，
他恰好是个玩偶制作师，
他就是这么告诉我的。他会
用各种各样的材料来做玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
He fashions them out of
Well-Tanned Leather, stuffs
them with Bird Feathers, and
uses Cyfar or Zargon to make
the eyes. He even uses a Jellopy at the bottom to balance the doll.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
他用鞣制好的皮革来制作，
塞进羽毛作为填充物，
并使用赛依伐或刹勒空结晶
来制作眼睛。他甚至会在
底部放一个杰勒比结晶来平衡玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
I guess that goes to show
that things that seem useless
might actually be handy in some
way. So don't worry about having too much stuff. Sooner or later, it might be useful to someone.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
我想这说明了，那些看似
没用的东西，实际上可能在
某些方面派上用场。所以不要
担心东西太多，迟早有一天，
它们会对某人有用。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you just pay me money,
I'll be your slave! There's
nothing I won't do! Anything
is fair game. Hell, I'll get buck naked if you pay me enough.
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要你给我钱，
我就是你的奴隶！没有
我做不到的事！任何事
都可以。嘿，要是给够钱，
我连衣服都能脱光。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you pay me what I'm
worth, I'll work hard at
any task you set me to.
Sure, mining's rough, but
as long as the zeny's coming
in, I'm happy. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要你付得起我的
身价，无论你交给我
什么样的任务，我都会
努力完成。没错，挖矿很累，
但只要泽尼进账，
我就很开心。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Hey. Why are you
looking at me like
that? There's no idle
chatting allowed at work.
If Canphotii catches
you, you'll be punished...
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
喂。你干嘛
那样看着我？
工作时间不允许闲聊。
要是被坎福蒂发现，
你会受罚的...

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Oh wait...
You don't work here.
I apologize, that kind
of reaction's an old
habit for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
噢等等...
你不是在这里工作的。
抱歉，冒险者，这种
反应是我的老习惯了。

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Do you know why a woman
like me has to work in this
factory? I'll tell you why...
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
你知道为什么像我这样的
女人必须在这家工厂工作吗？
我告诉你原因...

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
My lazy husband, Gesin,
is just lying there on the
ground! So I have to work
in order to support us!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
我那懒惰的丈夫格辛，
就那样躺在地上！
所以我必须工作来养家糊口！

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
We can't rest for even
a second if we want to save
enough money to become
wealthy and powerful some
day. Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
如果我们想攒够钱，
将来变得富有且强大，
就一秒钟都不能休息。
你不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Well, my husband obviously
doesn't! How can he not know
how the real world works?!
Hey, kick his ass for me if
he doesn't wake up soon!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
哎，我丈夫显然不明白！
他怎么会不知道现实世界的
运作方式呢？！
喂，要是他还不快点清醒，
就帮我踢他屁股！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
There was a time
when I dreamed of
being an adventurer,
just like you. But that
was a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
曾经我也梦想过
成为一名冒险者，
就像你一样。但那已经是
很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Now, I'm nothing but
a factory manager. Still,
even if my job's not that
great, I'm pretty satisfied.
I'm sure people enjoy the
products I oversee and all...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
现在，我只不过是
一名工厂经理。不过，
即使我的工作不算多出色，
我也挺满意的。我相信人们
一定很喜欢我监管的产品...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Maybe my life was meant
to be this way, even if it's
not how I planned it. But the
time will come when I up and
leave and travel the world
once I get my chance!
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
也许我的生活注定如此，
即便这并非我最初的计划。
但总有一天，一旦有机会，
我会毅然离开，去环游世界！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
I hope the day will
come when I can meet
you out in that big wide
world and greet you as
a fellow adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
我希望有一天，
能在广阔的世界里与你相遇，
并以同伴冒险者的身份
向你问好。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Arrrgh!
This is killing me!
Why should I be rich?
What's wrong with living
within our means?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
啊啊啊！
这简直要了我的命！
为什么我一定要变富有？
量入为生活有什么不好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
I've got no problem
with my current way
of life, but the old ball
and chain disagrees.
Why is she so obsessed
with riches and power?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
我对目前的生活方式
没什么意见，但那个老是
缠着我的累赘却不答应。
她为什么对财富和权力
如此痴迷？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Well, in any case, I'd
like to help her, but I can't
get up! I'm exhausted and
my body is just overtaxed.
I have no strength at all.
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
不管怎样，我也想帮帮她，
但我起不来啊！我精疲力竭，
身体已经透支了。
我一点力气都没有。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
This is horrible~
I should be resting
instead of worrying
about making money...
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
这太糟糕了~
我应该在休息，
而不是担心赚钱的事...

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Good god!
I'm so stressed!
It's been nonstop
since I moved here!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
天哪！
压力太大了！
自从搬到这里以后，
就没停歇过！

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
The work is tough and
already the boss hates
me! I didn't move here
for this! Still, the pay is
decent so I guess I should
endure just a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
工作很辛苦，老板还
讨厌我！我搬来这里
可不是为了这个！不过，
薪水还算不错，我想我应该
再坚持一下。

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Here goes...!
Yo-heave-ho!
Yo-heave-ho~!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
要开始了...！
嘿咻——！
嘿咻——！

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
It's great that the
factory is making good
business and drawing
in a lot of profit, but I still
have one major concern.
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
工厂生意兴隆、利润丰厚
固然是件好事，但我心里
始终有一个巨大的隐忧。

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
The amount of pollution
that this place is causing
is horrific! We've got these
machines blowing out toxic
gas all day long! The air
can't be safe for very long...
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
这里造成的污染程度
简直太可怕了！这些机器
整天都在排放有毒气体！
空气恐怕很快就无法维持
安全了...

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
I mean, the air we're
breathing right now is
pretty foul and things
are only going to get
worse. How can we
solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
我是说，我们现在呼吸的
空气已经相当难闻了，而且
情况只会变得越来越糟。
我们该如何解决这个问题？

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Staring at this
bubbling hot liquid
metal gives me a good
feeling inside. It's like
that stuff can melt anything!
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
盯着这些沸腾的
熔融金属，会让我
感到心情舒畅。感觉
那玩意儿能融化一切！

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Imagine covering an
entire street of people
with that stuff! Bwahah--
Oh, I'm sorry if I'm talking
crazy talk! I'm just kidding~
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
想象一下，用那玩意儿
覆盖整条街道的人群！
哇哈哈——
噢，如果我说了些疯话
请见谅！我只是在开玩笑~

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Machines are sooo
convenient. Just look
at this contraption easily
do tasks that'd be tough
for me to finish alone.
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
机器真是太方便了。
看看这个装置，能轻而易举地
完成那些我一个人很难
搞定的任务。

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Now this is what
I call technology!
Sure, it takes effort and
money to make one of
these, but what do I care?
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
这才是真正的技术！
没错，制造这种东西需要
投入大量精力和金钱，
但我又何必在意呢？

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
I've got no problems,
so long as this freaking
thing keeps working the
way I want it to!
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
只要这该死的玩意儿
能一直按我的意愿
运转下去，我就没问题！

scripts.text:
[Khashurantze]
I'm sorry, but you need
special authority in order
to enter this place. I'll have
to ask you to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡舒兰策]
很抱歉，进入这里需要
特殊的权限。我必须
请您现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
I'm in charge of this
blast furnace which
contains all of this
boiling magma.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
我负责管理这台
高炉，里面装满了
这些沸腾的岩浆。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Even though it doesn't
require actual labor, this
job is pretty tiring. I've got
to pay careful attention all
the time. It's pretty stressful.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
虽然不需要实际的体力劳动，
但这份工作相当累人。
我必须时刻保持高度警惕，
压力非常大。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Still, I'm proud of my job
since I have the responsibility
of ensuring employee safety.
Anyway, don't get too close
to the furnace. It won't do if
you get burned on accident!
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
尽管如此，我仍为自己的工作
感到自豪，因为我肩负着
确保员工安全的责任。
总之，别离高炉太近。
要是被意外烫伤了可就麻烦了！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Hustle, hustle!
Pick up the pace!
Anyone working too
slowly will be punished!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
快点，快点！
加快速度！
动作太慢的人都会受到
惩罚！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Can't you understand
that?! Now go to your
station and get back to
work! Wait, are you even
an employee? If not, then
stop wandering around!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你听不懂吗？！
现在立刻回你的岗位
继续工作！等等，你到底
是不是员工？如果不是，
就别在这儿闲逛了！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
You're not supposed
to be able to get in here!
I can't believe they let you
in! This requires extreme
disciplinary action!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你不应该能进到这里的！
真不敢相信他们竟然让你
进来了！这必须进行
严厉的纪律处分！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
This factory has a lot
of things that need fixing,
pronto! I'm amazed that
the place is still operating!
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
这家工厂有很多东西
需要立刻修理！
真不敢相信这里居然
还在维持运转！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
Lucky for us, I hear that
some altruistic adventurers
have been donating materials
to help keep this factory from
falling apart... Or worse.
But that's just a rumor.
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
算我们运气好，我听说
有些无私的冒险者一直在
捐赠材料，以此来帮助
维持工厂不至于彻底崩溃...
或者变得更糟。不过，那只是传闻。

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Even if it is true,
there's nothing no one
here can do. Nobody has
the courage to challenge
the system, you know?
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
^666666*唉*^000000
就算那是真的，
这里也没人能做得了什么。
没人有勇气去挑战
现有的体制，你懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
I...
I better get
back to work
before I get
in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
我...
我最好还是赶快
回去工作，免得
惹上麻烦...
